.notes: This file is used to generate the root tsconfig.json file external to all units - it enables cross-unit code dependencies without needing to `npm install` or update!

When generating the real root tsconfig.json need to modify the following properties: (1) delete `'.notes'`, (2) define `compilerOptions.baseUrl` as an absolute path, (3) populate `compilerOptions.paths`, and (4) populate `references`
